thread:
oncall-incident-bot: HIGH-Priority page: Routing layer errors observed in eu-west-1 Dedicated cluster. Error 502s for model routing. Paging #oncall. Root cause unknown. Please acknowledge and join thread.

jamie (SRE): acked, I'm on it. collecting logs now.

sam (Oncall): taking initial ownership, will coordinate mitigation. can anyone pull the customer-impact list?

priya (Account Exec): Priya here — quick FYI: impacted enterprise customers with reserved capacity in eu-west-1: ThermoNet Inc., AuroraPay, Maple Health Systems, and Veridian Analytics. I have primary contacts for each.

alex (Customer Success): copying preferred contacts: ThermoNet -> rachel@thermonet.com (SRE lead), AuroraPay -> ops@aurorapay.com (oncall alias), Maple Health -> cs-lead@maplehealth.com (CISO + platform PM), Veridian -> account@veridian.ai. All requested status via email and Slack.

jamie (SRE): logs show 502s from the routing proxy to the model router. Error: `upstream connection reset by peer` on 10.200.x.x. I'm seeing increased connection churn when routing to dedicated pools.

eva (Eng): tagging — might be related to the recent kernel patch on the dedicated fleet that changed keepalive defaults. rolling back a kernel flag on a canary node helped in staging.

sam (Oncall): mitigation plan: 1) add routing fallback to compatible variant (soft-fail to latest-compatible model) 2) reduce connection pooling aggressiveness 3) roll back kernel flag if fallback doesn't reduce errors. Doing step 1 now.

lee (Support): prepping customer-facing language. Need one-sentence impact and ETA to resolution for status page + emails.

maria (PM): For enterprise notices we need tailored impact statements per account — mention rate-limited generation and possible failed API responses for in-flight requests. Avoid technical root cause in customer-facing comms.

alex (Customer Success): Draft for ThermoNet (high-touch): "We are experiencing intermittent failures for model inference in eu-west-1 affecting ThermoNet's dedicated capacity. Some requests may receive errors (502) or delayed responses. Our engineering team is actively mitigating and we expect a reduction in errors within 30 minutes. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

alex (Customer Success): Draft for AuroraPay (payments): "AuroraPay - We are seeing failed inference requests in eu-west-1 which may impact payment routing decision latency. No evidence of data exposure. Our mitigation is in progress and we'll update within 30 minutes."

alex (Customer Success): Draft for Maple Health Systems (compliance): "Maple Health - Dedicated inference capacity in eu-west-1 is experiencing intermittent API errors. We are actively working on mitigation. If you see failures, please switch to fallback region (us-east-1) while we resolve. We will provide a detailed incident report after recovery."

alex (Customer Success): Draft for Veridian Analytics: "Veridian - Some inference requests to your dedicated cluster in eu-west-1 are failing with 502s. We're applying temporary routing fallbacks and expect service to stabilize shortly."

jamie (SRE): step 1 applied: routing fallback enabled via config flag `enable_model_variant_fallback=true` — immediate drop in error rate on two nodes. metrics: error rate down from 12% -> 4% in 3m.

statuspage-bot: Scheduled status update pending. Preview:
```
Incident: Routing errors affecting dedicated inference in eu-west-1
Impact: Some enterprise customers may experience failed requests (502) or increased latency.
Status: Mitigation in progress — temporary routing fallback enabled.
ETA: Reduced errors expected within 30 minutes.
Updates: Engineering investigating root cause; will provide further updates every 30 minutes.
```

lee (Support): sending to customers in 10m. Priya please confirm we can include the specific sentence about "no evidence of data exposure" for AuroraPay.

priya (Account Exec): confirmed for AuroraPay. For ThermoNet and Maple Health, they requested proactive postmortem and an ops-runbook to prevent recurrence. Note: Maple Health asked about fallback region; we included that.

eva (Eng): still seeing sporadic resets on node pool B. I'm preparing a rollback of the kernel keepalive flag. ETA 15 minutes to roll back on a canary and validate.

sam (Oncall): handoff — jamie you continue as primary on the mitigation, I'm pausing on-call duties to join customer briefings. jamie, ping me when you want me to push status page updates.

jamie (SRE): will do. current actions: monitor fallback effectiveness, if error rate <3% for 10m, continue; otherwise trigger kernel flag rollback.

statuspage-bot: Posted public update at 2026-03-15T15:02:00Z.

alex (Customer Success): sent tailored emails to all four contacts at 2026-03-15T15:05Z with the account-specific drafts above.

lee (Support): internal comms template (short):
"Hello team,
We are currently mitigating routing errors in eu-west-1 affecting dedicated inference. Impact: intermittent 502s and increased latency for reserved customers. Mitigation: temporary routing fallback in place; rollback in progress if needed. Action owners: jamie (SRE) — mitigation, eva (Eng) — kernel rollback validation, priya (AM) — customer comms. Next update in 30 minutes or when status changes."

maria (PM): also flagging billing implications for Dedicated — we should set customers' usage to "no-penalty" for the incident window. Priya, can you confirm ask with finance?

priya (Account Exec): yes, I'll flag to finance and request no-penalty credit for affected hours.

jamie (SRE): kernel flag rollback started on canary at 15:15 UTC, observing results. so far latency stable, errors trending down to ~1.2%.

eva (Eng): can confirm kernel rollback on canary looks good. prepping rollout to remaining nodes in the pool.

sam (Oncall): I'm re-joined; thanks jamie. Ready to post follow-up status update when you confirm stabilization.

jamie (SRE): rolling to remaining nodes now. ETA full rollout 12 minutes.

statuspage-bot: Posted public update at 2026-03-15T15:20:00Z: "Mitigation in progress; kernel rollback underway; expected resolution within ~15 minutes."

alex (Customer Success): customers acknowledged, ThermoNet asked for a scheduled postmortem call — Priya can you coordinate?

priya (Account Exec): on it, will propose times and include ops notes.

lee (Support): final internal close template when resolved: 
"Resolved: routing errors in eu-west-1. Root cause: connection churn triggered by kernel keepalive flag on dedicated fleet. Mitigation: routing fallback + kernel flag rollback. Customer impact: intermittent 502s for dedicated customers in eu-west-1 from 15:00-15:27 UTC. Credits requested. Postmortems scheduled with affected accounts."

jamie (SRE): errors at 0.2% across pool, rolling back complete. marking incident as "mitigated".

statuspage-bot: Update at 2026-03-15T15:27:00Z: "Service stabilized; mitigation complete. Full incident report will be published within 48 hours."

alex (Customer Success): sent post-recovery notes to customers at 15:29Z. ThermoNet responded with thanks and asked for SL adjustments — Priya to handle.

sam (Oncall): closing handoff — jamie if you want to add any ops notes here before we archive thread.

jamie (SRE): ops notes: add a healthcheck for connection resets to the routing proxy and add an automated rollback trigger for the kernel flag if reset rate exceeds 5% in 5m. I'll open the ticket after this.

lee (Support): archiving thread and creating ticket templates for future enterprise notices. Good work team :thumbsup:
